text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle and I have just wrapped up
a
training meeting, when...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Not yet? Ohhh... Come on! Come on!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fine and dandy! I'm just waitin' for my
folks to
message me back!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I wanna see their reaction to this video I
took.
Here, take a look!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mama! Hey, Papa! I wanna
introduce y'all to
the very heart of
Japan—cherry blossoms! You
see...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The soul of Japan is in these cherry
blossom
picnics they have! And I'm 'bout
to have one right
now! Ain't that right,
Fukukitaru? ♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Hi, Taiki's mama and papa! Come
to Japan
and see these lucky flowers for
yourselves!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I can't help smilin' when I watch it! I just
know
they'll—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, speak of the devil! My papa just
messaged
back!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Looks like they liked it too! He says, "Your video is so kawaii! Japanese spring looks wonderful! ♪"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Your clothes and way of speaking have
changed
so much. We could have sworn
you were...
Japanese"?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! Have I lost touch with my
Kentucky
roots?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: My folks said I seem Japanese!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I mean... I have tried my best to make lots of good memories here.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But what if I end up with only Japanese memories one day...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Am I gonna lose all my memories of back
home?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Noooo! That would be tragic! I love both
Japan
and America! I don't wanna forget
either!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... But... apparently I'm like a different person than I used to be!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain to her that every new memory
she has
gets added to her collection. It
doesn't mean
she'll lose her old ones.
choice_data_list: 大切な思い出が増えてるんだ
大切な思い出が増えてるんだよ
choice_data_list_en: I'm making more and more precious memories.
I'm making more and more precious memories, you know.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So it's like a big album with memories of
America
and Japan? Oh, I see... It's like
the clothes I was
wearing...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I chose the blouse 'cause it matched the
cherry
blossoms, and I wore the pants
with the stars on
'em 'cause I've always
loved stars.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And I like these cherry blossom picnics
'cause
they remind me of barbecues
back home!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's like I've... mixed the two memories
into one.
Right? That means...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's just like you said! I'm not losing
memories! I'm
getting new ones! I'm so
happy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's just like you said! I'm not losing
memories! I'm
getting new ones! I'm so
happy!
choice_data_list: もっと色んな思い出、作っていこう！
うん、私もハッピーだよ！
choice_data_list_en: Let's make lots more memories together!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm sure my folks'll want to see all
kinds of
new things that I'm up to!
choice_data_list: もっと色んな思い出、作っていこう！
うん、私もハッピーだよ！
choice_data_list_en: Let's make lots more memories together!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And what better time than now?! ☆ Let's
get
filming! You're on camera duty! ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, mmm, MMM, that's good! I've
been
wanting to try this! And since it's a

limited-time-only cherry blossom flavor,
you
could call it the taste of spring! ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ I got the seat right next to the
door! This
is the most popular seat on
the train here in
Japan!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And the last thing I wanna show you...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
This is Nakayama Racecourse, where the
Sprinters
Stakes is held! It's a real
barnburner!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So many skilled runners race here. And...
I'm doin'
my best to win, same as ever!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Actually... ever since I came here to
Japan and
met my trainer, I've been
running better than
ever!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
My memories give me strength... so I
wanna make
even more memories and
get even better!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She announces this passionately into the
camera,
clearly burning with even more
determination for
her future races!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! We're like two happy little peas in
a pod!
We gotta get this on video!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: C'mere! Stand right next to me! Ready?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mama! Hey, Papa! Me'n Trainer
here are
gonna be together forever,
happy as can be! ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
How so? You said you were happy,
didn't ya?
...Aaand sent!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That was quick! I already got a
reply! It's
for you! And in Japanese to
boot!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It says... "Dear Trainer. If you and Taiki
are
happy, we are happy!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yippee! Looks like everyone's happy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't be sure if they got the right
message, but
as long as Taiki Shuttle
seems happy, I suppose
it's okay.
